subject.title: feat(agents): return sessionId from sessions_spawn accept payload

question: Should accepted native `sessions_spawn` results publicly guarantee a durable `sessionId` in addition to the existing child session key?
rationale: The implementation is additive and proof-backed, but it expands the model-facing spawn-result contract and establishes a durable session-state identifier that callers may rely on.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept `sessionId` as the documented durable identity for native child sessions while preserving existing key fields.

options.title: Keep the existing key-only contract
options.body: Decline the additional field and direct callers to the existing session-key workflow if the durable UUID should remain internal.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept `sessionId` as the documented durable identity for native child sessions while preserving existing key fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the person who implemented and demonstrated the proposed contract; current-main ownership history was not available in the supplied review evidence.
